seo.description: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym and open-air fitness equipment to schools, societies and parks in Visakhapatnam. Made in our Vasai factory. Get a free quote.

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Visakhapatnam

c: Visakhapatnam has a long beach road, a major port, a steel plant township and a naval presence, all set between the hills and the Bay of Bengal. Each brings buyers who want outdoor exercise space. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Visakhapatnam for beachfront parks, industrial and port townships, colleges, schools and apartment complexes. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,110 km away.

Sea air, humidity and cyclones are facts of life in Vizag, and any outdoor gym here has to be built for them. Our frames are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded seats and handles, and on coastal sites we grout every post into concrete. We send a layout drawing first, then manufacture, dispatch by road and install through our team or a dealer in south India.

richText.heading: Building a beach road or township gym for coastal weather

c: On the beach road, keep the gym back from the sand line and on a firm pad, so drifting sand does not bury the footplates. Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks to clear salt. In hill areas of the city, level a terraced pad before installation.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed near Vizag's beach?
items.a: Yes, on a firm concrete pad set back from the sand. Galvanised frames and moulded parts resist salt, and regular fresh-water rinsing helps them last.

items.q: Do you supply steel plant and port townships?
items.a: We supply townships and campuses across India. Share the site details and any purchase requirements, and we will send machine details, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: What should be checked after a cyclone?
items.a: Bolts, frames and the base. If any machine has moved or a part is damaged, keep it out of use and contact our after-sales team.
